word.definition: To aggrandize someone (or something) is to enhance their power, wealth, position, or reputation.

quote.text: I don’t like the word "allegorical", I don’t like the word "symbolic", the word I really like is "mythic" and people always think that means "full of lies" when what it really means is full of a truth that cannot be told in any other way but a story.
quote.author: William Golding

history.text: Franco-Prussian War: The siege of Paris begins. The city held out for over four months before surrendering.
